verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows openness only on the ingest and collection side: OpenTelemetry and Prometheus ingest, and EDOT collection 'with no vendor lock-in'. Nothing documents exporting stored data in open formats or migrating out. Open ingest and open query languages are adjacent to the story and do not show a data-export or exit path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
